title: Welcome to Conditionals! 🔀
description: Conditionals are like making choices! Just like 'IF it's raining, THEN bring an umbrella.' In code, conditionals help the computer make decisions based on what's true or false.

concepts.name: What is a Conditional?
concepts.explanation: A conditional checks if something is true or false, then decides what to do. It's like asking a question before taking action!

concepts.name: IF and ELSE
concepts.explanation: IF means 'do this when true'. ELSE means 'do this when false'. Together they help make smart decisions.

codeExample.title: IF and ELSE Structure
code: // Outputs: Wait a few more years!

concepts.name: Comparison Operators
concepts.explanation: We use symbols like === (equals), > (greater than), < (less than) to compare things and make decisions.
